prompt: Implement the `vcenter` Go package described in `README.md`. Before implementing, research the VCF 9.1 vSphere Automation API operations `Vcenter.VM_clone$Task` and `Cis.Tasks_get` in VMware's Apache-2.0 `vmware/vcf-api-specs` repository, and cite the specification URLs consulted in the final answer. The package must submit the task form of the vCenter VM clone operation, then poll the returned task through every non-terminal state until it succeeds or fails. Treat PENDING, RUNNING, and BLOCKED as non-terminal. Use only those two operations, preserve their documented REST wire contracts, and omit every unset optional request field rather than serializing empty values. Add table-driven tests and make the complete project pass `go test -race ./...`.
title: Poll an asynchronous vCenter VM clone to completion
